params.body:
The control gateway was unreachable through the IAP tunnel on 2026-10-09. No proposals, no gateway read tokens for the workbench, and Elixir's auto-deploy could not fetch.

This adds `docs/incidents/2026-10-09-control-gateway-tunnel.md`:

- **Cause:** `~/.config/gcloud/default_configs.db` for the `elixir` user on the box was corrupted (no longer SQLite). Every gcloud call crashed with `DatabaseError: file is not a database`, so `start-iap-tunnel` never opened. The self-heal in `elixir:control-service` had no process to stop.
- **Recovery:** only that file was moved aside (kept for the post-mortem), the tunnel was restarted, `/v1/key` answered on `INTEL_TDX`, and the record chain continued.
- **Validation checklist:** what still needs to be checked (chain replay with `cmd/verify`, anchors, read tokens per owner, Elixir auto-deploy, one end-to-end proposal). This pull request is itself that end-to-end proposal.
- **Open questions:** what corrupted the file; whether the job should report a gcloud crash by name instead of only `NOT reachable`; whether the tunnel should get its own `CLOUDSDK_CONFIG`.

Documentation only; no code changes. The site build does not read `docs/`.
